crossRefs.note: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!
Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord!
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!
By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.
The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
